popCulture.title: Description of Greece
popCulture.creator: Pausanias
popCulture.description: Pausanias' Theban and Heraclid antiquities — Tisamenus son of Thersander as the Epigon king's heir, still too young to lead when the sons of the Seven take Thebes.

popCulture.title: Tisamenus (King of Thebes)
popCulture.description: Theban king in the Epigon generation — son of Thersander, distinct from Tisamenus son of Orestes who dies in the Heraclid return.
